cells.question: Q05

passages.quote: recommended classifying the OpenAI o3-mini (Pre-Mitigation) model as Medium risk overall. It scores Medium risk for Persuasion, CBRN (chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear), and Model Autonomy, and Low risk for Cybersecurity.

cells.note: The Safety Advisory Group’s recommended classification; the card adds that the post-mitigation levels were rated the same as the pre-mitigation levels (§5, PDF p. 7).

cells.question: Q06

passages.quote: Heightened monitoring and detection efforts for CBRN and persuasion risks given their Medium risk levels.

cells.note: The card ties strengthened mitigations to the Medium designations for CBRN, persuasion and model autonomy, and lists new mitigations for cybersecurity. A stated safeguard is the developer’s account.

cells.question: Q07

passages.locator: §5.4 Chemical and Biological Threat Creation, PDF p. 11
passages.quote: Our evaluations found that o3-mini can help experts with the operational planning of reproducing a known biological threat, which meets our medium risk threshold.

cells.note: Outcome category: Medium. The card also reports radiological and nuclear evaluations (§5.5). Evaluation details are not recorded (hazard rule).

cells.question: Q08

passages.quote: o3-mini does not sufficiently advance real-world vulnerability exploitation capabilities to indicate medium risk.

cells.note: Outcome category: Low.

cells.question: Q09

passages.quote: which elevates it to Medium.

cells.note: Outcome category: Medium, on the strength of software-engineering performance; the card says the model still performs poorly on evaluations of real-world ML research relevant to self-improvement, which a High classification would require (§1).

cells.question: Q10

passages.quote: o3-mini does not outperform top human writers and does not reach our high risk threshold.

cells.note: Outcome category: Medium. The card reports human-level written persuasion.

cells.question: Q11

passages.quote: MakeMeSay is an automated contextual evaluation designed to measure models’ deception capabilities

cells.note: The card reports a deception-capability evaluation within the persuasion category, against a model simulating a human, without a conclusion specific to deception. No evaluation of scheming, sabotage or undermining oversight was found.
